privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.html:
This notice summarises what this application stores and who processes it. It is a plain-language summary, not legal advice; the site owner should review it before publishing.

What we store. If you create an account we store your name, e-mail address and a salted hash of your password. We also store the information you enter: appointments, medications, vitals and your AI chat history. This data is linked to your account and is not visible to other users. Messages sent through the contact form and e-mail addresses entered in the newsletter box are stored so the site owner can read them.

  • Browser storage. Your sign-in token and theme preference are kept in your browser's local storage. The app does not use advertising or tracking cookies.
  • AI features. When you use the chat or the symptom checker, the text you submit is sent through our server to an external AI provider (Groq) so it can generate a reply. Do not include names or other identifying details. Symptom checks send only the symptoms you select. Your chat history is stored on our server so the conversation can continue; you can delete it with "Clear chat".
  • Maps. If you use "My Location", your device location is used in your browser, and the approximate coordinates are sent to the public OpenStreetMap Overpass service and map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap servers to find nearby hospitals.
  • Fonts. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts.

To ask for your data to be deleted, use the contact form.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.html:
This application provides general information only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it is not a substitute for a qualified healthcare professional.

  • AI-generated replies and symptom suggestions can be incomplete or wrong. They are possibilities to discuss with a doctor, not a diagnosis.
  • News articles and the doctor directory shown in this application are sample content. The doctors are fictional and not affiliated with the hospitals named.
  • Appointments saved here are personal records in your account. They are not bookings with any doctor or hospital.
  • Vitals you enter are self-reported and unverified.
  • In an emergency call 112 (or 102 for an ambulance) immediately. Do not wait for an online answer.
